chunks: It may be that God will create love between you and those you have been enemies of among them. And God is All-Powerful, and God is Forgiving, Ever-Merciful.
ai.seo_question: What does the Quran say about turning enemies into friends?
ai.summary: In the context of Surah Al-Mumtahanah, this verse (60:9) serves as a bridge between the prohibition of alliance with hostile polytheists (60:8) and the permission for peaceful interaction with those who do not fight believers (60:10). It underscores the Shia understanding that divine power (Qadir) and mercy (Ghafur Rahim) can transform historical enmity into genuine affection (Mawaddah), provided the other party remains non-aggressive. This highlights the dynamic nature of diplomatic relations in Islamic jurisprudence, moving from strict caution to potential reconciliation.
